# Public Sapling bundle fixture

Public mainnet V5 transaction `ca6abd8ef7d6ef158a4a35ea2c2c0cf122f2f664a88f8fa5b6fd79e48c5bed59`
(one Sapling spend, one Sapling output, `valueBalanceSapling` 1000, no transparent
parts) from block `00000000017d40c50ef7f27bd2e997ed5d1009a332e4fa85b9939652b8dd516b`
at height 1,687,106. It was re-serialized from the block test vector
`crates/zakura-test/src/vectors/block-main-1-687-106.txt` (SHA-256
`0e0c7456caacfc7b48839bd603e3426c456d02f972a2f33dfc07d4d7bddc4776`) in the
zakura checkout at revision `1faf150fc3648aae22c55a6b30f8f5a9b9ce934e`, which
Enhance pins. Enhance does not depend on `zakura-test`, so the transaction is
copied here.

`tests/mixed_fee.rs` moves only its Sapling bundle into a synthetic V6
transaction and replaces the bundle's value balance with a hand-set amount, to
check that the whole-transaction fee includes the Sapling pool. Proofs and
signatures are not verified by fee derivation. This is public chain data, not a
wallet export.
